MasulloGRH.classCharacter_mk.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K] (χ : UnitaryHeckeCharacter K)

MasulloGRH.globalConvolution_inverse_character.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (HeckeIdeleClasses K)] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure (HeckeIdeleClasses K))
  (χ : UnitaryHeckeCharacter K) (φ : HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K) :
  globalConvolution K μ φ (fun y => (complexClassCharacter K χ) y⁻¹) x =
    (∫ (g : HeckeIdeleClasses K), φ g * (complexClassCharacter K χ) g ∂μ) * (complexClassCharacter K χ) x⁻¹

MasulloGRH.globalConvolution_logarithmicMode.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (HeckeIdeleClasses K)] [OpensMeasurableSpace (HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure (HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ]
  (φ : HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hφ : Continuous φ) (hc : HasCompactSupport φ) (c : HeckeQuasicharacter K)
  (L : HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hL : Continuous L) (hshift : ∀ (g x : HeckeIdeleClasses K), L (g⁻¹ * x) = L x - L g)
  (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K) :
  globalConvolution K μ φ (fun y => (quasiClassCharacter K c) y⁻¹ * L y) x =
    (∫ (g : HeckeIdeleClasses K), φ g * (quasiClassCharacter K c) g ∂μ) * ((quasiClassCharacter K c) x⁻¹ * L x) -
      (∫ (g : HeckeIdeleClasses K), φ g * (quasiClassCharacter K c) g * L g ∂μ) * (quasiClassCharacter K c) x⁻¹

MasulloGRH.globalConvolutionEndomorphism_logarithmicMode.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (HeckeIdeleClasses K)] [OpensMeasurableSpace (HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure (HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ]
  (φ : HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hφ : Continuous φ) (hc : HasCompactSupport φ) (c : HeckeQuasicharacter K)
  (L : HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hL : Continuous L) (hshift : ∀ (g x : HeckeIdeleClasses K), L (g⁻¹ * x) = L x - L g) :
  (globalConvolutionEndomorphism K μ φ hφ hc)
      { toFun := fun y => (quasiClassCharacter K c) y⁻¹ * L y, continuous_toFun := ⋯ } =
    (∫ (g : HeckeIdeleClasses K), φ g * (quasiClassCharacter K c) g ∂μ) •
        { toFun := fun y => (quasiClassCharacter K c) y⁻¹ * L y, continuous_toFun := ⋯ } -
      (∫ (g : HeckeIdeleClasses K), φ g * (quasiClassCharacter K c) g * L g ∂μ) •
        { toFun := fun y => (quasiClassCharacter K c) y⁻¹, continuous_toFun := ⋯ }
'MasulloGRH.globalConvolutionEndomorphism_logarithmicMode' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
MasulloGRH.globalConvolution_generalizedModes.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (HeckeIdeleClasses K)] [OpensMeasurableSpace (HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure (HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ]
  (φ : HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hφ : Continuous φ) (hc : HasCompactSupport φ) (c : HeckeQuasicharacter K)
  (L : HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hL : Continuous L) (hshift : ∀ (g x : HeckeIdeleClasses K), L (g⁻¹ * x) = L x - L g)
  (n : ℕ) (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K) :
  globalConvolution K μ φ (fun y => (quasiClassCharacter K c) y⁻¹ * L y ^ n) x =
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      (∫ (g : HeckeIdeleClasses K), φ g * (quasiClassCharacter K c) g * (-L g) ^ j ∂μ) *
          ((quasiClassCharacter K c) x⁻¹ * L x ^ (n - j)) *
        ↑(n.choose j)

  (c : MasulloGRH.HeckeQuasicharacter K) (L : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hL : Continuous L)
  (hshift : ∀ (g x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), L (g⁻¹ * x) = L x - L g) (n : ℕ)
  (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K) :
  MasulloGRH.globalConvolution K μ φ (fun y => (MasulloGRH.quasiClassCharacter K c) y⁻¹ * L y ^ n) x =
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      (∫ (g : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), φ g * (MasulloGRH.quasiClassCharacter K c) g * (-L g) ^ j ∂μ) *
          ((MasulloGRH.quasiClassCharacter K c) x⁻¹ * L x ^ (n - j)) *
        ↑(n.choose j)
